braids.your_reading: The audit instruments — each one a said-vs-saved device pointed at a new substrate. J-lens: poised-to-say vs actually-said, from inside the model. Goodfire: neuron concept vs human label, bottom-up. The capsule: tamper-evident storage for decisions. They converge on one point: every substrate has a said and a saved, and the gap is always where the work is.
